modules.name: Foundations
modules.description: Exam anatomy, the BACCM, key terms, requirements classification, stakeholder roles, how a BABOK task is built, the diagnostic exam, and the input/output backbone of the whole guide.

lessons.name: Welcome to GreenBasket & your CBAP game plan
lessons.description: Your first day at GreenBasket, and the exam game plan.

lessons.name: The BACCM: six lenses on every change
lessons.description: The six core concepts that every BABOK task is built on.

lessons.name: Requirements classification & requirements vs designs
lessons.description: Business, stakeholder, solution (functional and non-functional), and transition requirements.

lessons.name: Stakeholders: the 11 generic roles
lessons.description: Who is who, in BABOK terms, at GreenBasket.

lessons.name: Anatomy of a BABOK task & how to study the Guide
lessons.description: The 8-part structure behind all 30 tasks, and how to read the BABOK efficiently.

lessons.name: Diagnostic exam (50 questions)
lessons.description: Find your baseline. No pressure, no studying for it.

lessons.name: Diagnostic review & your personal focus plan
lessons.description: Turn your diagnostic into a personal plan.

lessons.name: The big map: how the 30 tasks hand off to each other
lessons.description: The input/output backbone that answers "what comes next?" questions.

lessons.name: Underlying competencies & perspectives: a primer
lessons.description: The skills and lenses that frame every scenario.

lessons.name: Foundation checkpoint
lessons.description: Lock in the foundations before Knowledge Area deep dives.

modules.name: Business Analysis Planning & Monitoring (14%)
modules.description: Plan how business analysis will be done on GreenBasket Click & Collect: approach, stakeholder engagement, governance, information management, and improving BA performance.

lessons.name: BAPM overview + 3.1 Plan Business Analysis Approach
lessons.description: Predictive or adaptive? Choosing how BA work gets done.

lessons.name: 3.2 Plan Stakeholder Engagement
lessons.description: Stakeholder analysis, collaboration and communication needs, with Marcus.

lessons.name: 3.3 Plan Business Analysis Governance
lessons.description: Who decides, who approves, and how changes are controlled.

lessons.name: 3.4 Plan Business Analysis Information Management
lessons.description: Organization, abstraction, traceability approach, reuse, storage and attributes.

lessons.name: 3.5 Identify Business Analysis Performance Improvements
lessons.description: Measuring and improving the BA work itself.

lessons.name: BAPM techniques lab: estimation, item tracking, lessons learned, reviews
lessons.description: Hands-on with the techniques BAPM relies on.

lessons.name: BAPM exam drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Prove BAPM mastery.

modules.name: Elicitation & Collaboration (12%)
modules.description: Prepare, conduct and confirm elicitation; communicate BA information; manage stakeholder collaboration. Includes a live interview role-play with a GreenBasket picker.

lessons.name: E&C overview + 4.1 Prepare for Elicitation
lessons.description: Plan an elicitation activity: scope, techniques, logistics, materials, people.

lessons.name: 4.2 Conduct Elicitation: live interview with Kim
lessons.description: You interview Kim Tran, the picker who knows why Harvest failed.

lessons.name: 4.3 Confirm Elicitation Results
lessons.description: Compare against sources and other results. Who was right about pick time?

lessons.name: 4.4 Communicate Business Analysis Information
lessons.description: Same findings, three audiences: Elena, Marcus, the vendors.

lessons.name: 4.5 Manage Stakeholder Collaboration
lessons.description: Marcus cancels again. Keep collaboration alive.

lessons.name: Elicitation techniques lab: choosing the right technique
lessons.description: Workshops, focus groups, surveys, observation, brainstorming, prototyping: when to use each.

lessons.name: E&C exam drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Prove E&C mastery.

modules.name: Requirements Life Cycle Management (15%)
modules.description: Trace, maintain and prioritize requirements and designs; assess a disruptive change request (same-day delivery); gain approval with conflicting stakeholders.

lessons.name: RLCM overview + 5.1 Trace Requirements
lessons.description: Derive, depends, satisfy, validate: building the chain of "why".

lessons.name: 5.2 Maintain Requirements
lessons.description: Keep requirements accurate, attributed and reusable.

lessons.name: 5.3 Prioritize Requirements
lessons.description: Everyone says "High". Run a prioritization that holds up.

lessons.name: 5.4 Assess Requirements Changes: CR-017 same-day delivery
lessons.description: Marketing wants delivery in release 1, with media already booked.

lessons.name: 5.5 Approve Requirements
lessons.description: Consensus, conflict and sign-off, without a Harvest-style rubber stamp.

lessons.name: RLCM techniques lab: decision analysis, backlog management, business rules
lessons.description: Decision matrices, backlogs and business rules in practice.

lessons.name: RLCM exam drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Prove RLCM mastery.

modules.name: Strategy Analysis (15%)
modules.description: Current state, future state, risks and change strategy for Click & Collect, plus the business case and financial analysis that the CFO demands.

lessons.name: SA overview + 6.1 Analyze Current State
lessons.description: Why must GreenBasket change? Root causes, capabilities, and business requirements.

lessons.name: 6.2 Define Future State
lessons.description: Goals, SMART objectives, constraints, assumptions and potential value.

lessons.name: 6.3 Assess Risks
lessons.description: Risk of changing and of not changing, plus risk tolerance.

lessons.name: 6.4 Define Change Strategy
lessons.description: Gap analysis, readiness, transition states, and the solution scope.

lessons.name: Lab: business case & financial analysis (NPV, IRR, ROI, payback)
lessons.description: The CFO wants numbers. You give numbers.

lessons.name: Lab: strategy techniques (BMC, capability analysis, benchmarking, balanced scorecard)
lessons.description: The strategy toolkit, applied.

lessons.name: SA exam drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Prove SA mastery.

modules.name: Requirements Analysis & Design Definition (30%)
modules.description: The biggest KA. Specify and model requirements (all five model categories), verify and validate, architect, define design options, and recommend a solution: ShelfWise vs CodeHarbor vs OmniGrocer.

lessons.name: RADD overview + 7.1 Specify & Model I: model categories and abstraction
lessons.description: Five model categories, and choosing the right level of abstraction.

lessons.name: 7.1 Specify & Model II: process models, use cases, user stories
lessons.description: Model the pick-and-handover flow three ways.

lessons.name: 7.1 Specify & Model III: data & information models
lessons.description: Data model, data dictionary, glossary, DFD, concept and state models.

lessons.name: 7.2 Verify Requirements
lessons.description: Tom's list, torn apart by quality characteristics.

lessons.name: 7.3 Validate Requirements
lessons.description: Do these requirements actually deliver the business objectives?

lessons.name: RADD mid-point drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Half of RADD done. Check it sticks.

lessons.name: 7.4 Define Requirements Architecture
lessons.description: Viewpoints, views, completeness: how it all fits together.

lessons.name: 7.5 Define Design Options
lessons.description: Build, buy or hybrid? Allocate requirements to components.

lessons.name: 7.6 Analyze Potential Value and Recommend Solution
lessons.description: Score the options and make the call, even if it isn't the sponsor's favourite.

lessons.name: RADD techniques lab I: NFRs, acceptance criteria, prototyping, interface analysis
lessons.description: Qualities, interfaces and prototypes.

lessons.name: RADD techniques lab II: decision modelling, roles & permissions, functional decomposition, scope models
lessons.description: Decision tables, access rights and decomposition.

lessons.name: RADD final drill (40 questions)
lessons.description: Close out the biggest KA.

modules.name: Solution Evaluation (14%)
modules.description: The 6-store pilot has run for 10 weeks. Measure it, analyze variances, separate solution limitations from enterprise limitations, and recommend actions.

lessons.name: SE overview + 8.1 Measure Solution Performance
lessons.description: Ten weeks of pilot data. What should you measure?

lessons.name: 8.2 Analyze Performance Measures
lessons.description: Trends, variances and accuracy in the pilot data.

lessons.name: 8.3 Assess Solution Limitations
lessons.description: What inside the solution is holding value back?

lessons.name: 8.4 Assess Enterprise Limitations
lessons.description: Incentives, culture, structure: the problems outside the software.

lessons.name: 8.5 Recommend Actions to Increase Solution Value
lessons.description: Before chain-wide rollout: what should change?

lessons.name: SE techniques lab: metrics & KPIs, data mining, vendor assessment, root cause
lessons.description: The measurement toolkit.

lessons.name: SE exam drill + Phase 2 milestone
lessons.description: Finish Phase 2: all 30 tasks done.

modules.name: Consolidation: techniques, perspectives, competencies
modules.description: All 50 techniques compared in families, the 5 perspectives, and the underlying competencies. Plus the technique matrix you will revise from in weeks 11–13.

lessons.name: Technique families I: elicitation & collaboration techniques
lessons.description: Compare the look-alikes: interviews, workshops, focus groups, surveys, observation, brainstorming, collaborative games, document analysis, reviews, lessons learned.

lessons.name: Technique families II: modelling techniques
lessons.description: Process, use case, user story, sequence, state, data, DFD, concept, decision, scope, org, roles & permissions, functional decomposition, prototyping.

lessons.name: Technique families III: analysis, decision & estimation techniques
lessons.description: Decision analysis, risk, financial, prioritization, estimation, business rules, NFR, interface, acceptance criteria, item tracking, backlog, glossary, data dictionary.

lessons.name: Technique families IV: strategy & measurement techniques
lessons.description: SWOT, BMC, business capability analysis, business cases, balanced scorecard, benchmarking, metrics & KPIs, data mining, root cause, process analysis, vendor assessment, stakeholder list/map/personas.

lessons.name: Perspectives I: Agile, Business Intelligence, Information Technology
lessons.description: How BA work shifts in agile, BI and IT contexts.

lessons.name: Perspectives II: Business Architecture & Business Process Management
lessons.description: Enterprise-level models and process improvement.

lessons.name: Underlying competencies deep-dive + consolidation quiz
lessons.description: Name the competency behind the behaviour, then a 30-question consolidation.

modules.name: Exam simulation & final preparation
modules.description: Exam technique, three full 120-question mocks under exam conditions, targeted gap-closing sprints, case-study clinic, final review and exam-day playbook.

lessons.name: Exam technique: reading case studies, elimination, time management
lessons.description: How to think like the exam.

lessons.name: Full Mock Exam #1 (120 questions, 210 minutes)
lessons.description: The first full simulation.

lessons.name: Mock #1 deep review & gap plan
lessons.description: Every wrong AND every guessed answer, reviewed against the BABOK.

lessons.name: Gap-closing sprint I
lessons.description: Targeted re-teach + drills on your top gaps.

lessons.name: Case-study clinic: long multi-KA scenarios
lessons.description: The long cases that decide pass or fail.

lessons.name: Full Mock Exam #2
lessons.description: Second simulation, weighted to your weak areas.

lessons.name: Mock #2 review & gap plan II
lessons.description: Review, and decide whether the exam date holds.

lessons.name: Gap-closing sprint II
lessons.description: Final targeted sprint.

lessons.name: Final Mock Exam #3: go/no-go
lessons.description: The go/no-go signal.

lessons.name: Final review: I/O map, technique sheet, confusions, glossary sprint
lessons.description: Light, high-yield review. No new material.

lessons.name: Exam-day playbook & confidence
lessons.description: Logistics, mindset, and your personal playbook.
